'''Unkorsa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologist]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She sold [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] on [[Carrick Station]].
